WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    p.death_country,
    AVG(CAST(pav.points_won AS REAL) / CAST(pav.points_max AS REAL)) as avg_ratio
  FROM player_award_vote pav
  JOIN player p ON pav.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL
    AND pav.points_won IS NOT NULL
    AND pav.points_max IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.death_country
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_avg_ratio
  FROM step1
)
SELECT 
  step1.death_country,
  step1.avg_ratio,
  step1.avg_ratio / step2.overall_avg_ratio as ratio_of_averages
FROM step1
CROSS JOIN step2
WHERE step2.overall_avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
